scope: Legacy and synthetic packs remain workflow-only. public_sources packs allow workflow and factual use with factual_authority=false. Published records may contain independent summaries and short quotations within their stated rights_status; complete retrieved originals remain at local repository-relative evidence_path and need not be published. retrieved_at records the actual collection time; read_evidence reuses the research record's reading evidence and locators. sha256 covers the complete retrieved original at evidence_path, not an excerpt, using check_delivery.sha256_file: binary files byte-for-byte and text files with canonical LF newlines. workflow checks public record metadata and allows unavailable local originals; factual also requires original files and matching hashes. Content and read_evidence accuracy require independent research review.

ai_knowledge_sanitized.rights_status: Original-document reuse rights have not been independently re-established. Do not publish private originals or call this rights-cleared factual data.

excluded_claims.text: 中国AI模型Token周调用量（4.12万亿）首次超越美国（2.94万亿），全球开发者生态市场份额实现质变
excluded_claims.reason: The undated key point and summary give different weekly token totals (4.12 and 5.16 trillion) without identifying the respective weeks or measurement population. Neither is retained as a numeric benchmark.
excluded_claims.evidence: Internal comparison of S007 at b541a667b89a4ea9da8fffd8d58851e5f03b795e; no missing date was invented.

excluded_claims.text: 与此同时，2月中国模型单周Token调用量（5.16万亿）已显著超越美国（2.94万亿），三周增长127%。
excluded_claims.reason: Same unresolved measurement-window conflict as the excluded S007 key point; exclusion is not a finding that both numbers are necessarily false.
excluded_claims.evidence: Internal comparison of S007 at b541a667b89a4ea9da8fffd8d58851e5f03b795e.

excluded_claims.text: 腾讯提出XGBoost梯度提升决策树算法并多次在Kaggle竞赛夺冠，NLP系统TexSmart在腾讯内部实现数千亿次调用
excluded_claims.reason: The clause attributes the invention of XGBoost to Tencent. The original 2016 paper is by Tianqi Chen and Carlos Guestrin at the University of Washington. The combined key point is removed rather than silently repaired from an unrelated source.
